BHP BILLITON PLC – TRANSACTION IN SHARES

Name of entities
BHP Billiton Limited ABN 49 004 028 077
BHP Billiton Plc REG NO 3196209
                

BHP Billiton Limited announces that it yesterday purchased 640,327 Ordinary shares of BHP Billiton Plc at an average price of 2,522.17 pence per Ordinary share. The highest price paid was 2,542.50 pence per Ordinary share and the lowest price paid was 2,498.00 pence per Ordinary share.

Following purchase, BHP Billiton Limited transferred its interest in the shares to BHP Billiton Plc for nil consideration and cancellation by BHP Billiton Plc.

Following the cancellation, the total number of BHP Billiton Plc Ordinary shares in issue (excluding shares held as treasury shares) will be 2,187,306,292.

Further information on BHP Billiton can be found on our Internet site: www.bhpbilliton.com
